name: SEKA SPEAR RDC
why_interesting: A premium domestic aero platform with a claimed 685 g bare frame, threaded BSA bottom bracket and a separately documented 7.1 kg custom build.
missing: Proof that the reported price maps to the complete listed build
Current mainland exact-SKU checkout and stock
Frame weight in the owner's MR size
Full custom-bike BOM is not established by the official frameset package

facts.drivetrain: Shimano Ultegra electronic; exact series unconfirmed
facts.frame: Spear RDC frame in the owner's racing MR size. SEKA's weights are for size M: 685 g bare without paint or metal parts, and 729 g ±35 g in Shadow Black; the store prints 685 g ±35 g. MR is unpublished.
facts.frame_material: TeXtreme base layers with DIALEAD pitch-based ultra-high-modulus and Pyrofil carbon, plus PMI foam filling
facts.frame_construction: One-mould True-One-Piece frame; internal routing through SEKA's Rapier bar system
facts.bottom_bracket: BSA threaded, 68 mm (frame standard; BB component inclusion in the custom build is not established)
facts.cockpit: 375×120 mm integrated handlebar on the custom build; official frameset uses the Rapier integrated bar
facts.sizes: XS, S, M, L and XL, plus racing MR and LR
facts.warranty: Current China policy: lifetime SEKA frameset, five years for SEKA carbon parts, two years for SEKA spare parts; non-SEKA complete-build parts are not covered by this statement.
facts.stiffness_evidence: SEKA reports a 14.5% stiffness-to-weight improvement and 5% more stiffness than Exceed RDC, plus 109 N/mm vertical compliance; manufacturer comparisons with limited public protocol detail
facts.tire_clearance_basis: Official maximum actual tyre width, front and rear, on SEKA's current global and China pages; the 2024–25 catalog also lists 32c. A 35 mm tyre exceeds SEKA's stated limit.
facts.complete_weight_basis: Exact size-MR custom owner build with Shimano Ultegra electronic shifting and Voso Lite50 wheels: approximately 7.1 kg before pedals, bottle cages and computer mount; not a factory complete-bike SKU

source_note: Frame facts come from SEKA's official pages and catalog; this build's parts, 7.1 kg weight and ¥16,900 figure come from one owner report.
price_status: No current manufacturer-published price or checkout for the exact custom complete-bike build. The CNY 16,900 owner-reported list observation from 2026-08-17 remains historical; its mapping to this complete build is unverified.
purchase_route: SEKA China directs mainland buyers to an authorized dealer, official WeChat or official Taobao. The current global store exposes a frameset route only; an exact custom complete-bike listing, mainland stock and final checkout are unverified.
warranty: Current China policy: lifetime SEKA frameset warranty, five years for SEKA carbon parts and two years for SEKA spare parts; mainland service route is the seller, official WeChat or official Taobao. This does not establish warranty for non-SEKA parts in the custom build.

enrichment_reviews.scope: SEKA's current pages state the weight basis (size M, no paint or metal parts) and publish one geometry chart for RDC and Standard frames, resolving the earlier unclear weight basis and unmapped geometry. The 32 mm limit is unchanged; owner build, prices and dates retained.
